title: The Sun and the Wind
moral: Kindness is the strongest power of all. The end!
notes: 영어 읽어 주기 대본. text 는 한국어 줄(키), en 이 읽는 문장. reuse 는 narration_el_en.js 의 영어 녹음 그대로, trim 은 from 줄의 영어 녹음을 같은 문장 경계에서 자른 것, new 만 새로 녹음한다. 배역·연기 지시는 read_script_el.json 의 같은 줄을 따른다.

acts.set:<sky|high|field|stream>: 장면 배경(bgImage 키). scenes[].set 으로 자동 호출
acts.cut:<hat|hold|pant|off|shake>: 그림 컷 5장 — 컷 속 외침(VOICE_LINES cut_pant·cut_off)은 그대로 재사용

lines.en: High up in the sky lived the Sun and the Wind.
segs: High up in the sky lived the Sun and the Wind.

lines.text: 구름은 두둥실, 새들은 짹짹 하늘을 날아다녔어요.
lines.en: Clouds floated by, bob, bob, and birds flew about, tweet, tweet.
segs: Clouds floated by, bob, bob, and birds flew about, tweet, tweet.

lines.text: 해님은 방긋방긋 웃고, 바람은 볼을 빵빵하게 부풀렸어요.
lines.en: The Sun beamed a big, bright smile, and the Wind puffed out its cheeks, round and full.
segs: The Sun beamed a big, bright smile, and the Wind puffed out its cheeks, round and full.

lines.en: "I'm the warmest!"
"No way, I'm the strongest!"
The Sun and the Wind both say they're the best.
segs: The Sun and the Wind both say they're the best.

lines.en: A traveler is walking down the road below.
segs: A traveler is walking down the road below.

lines.en: The traveler trudged along, plod, plod, slow and steady.
segs: The traveler trudged along, plod, plod, slow and steady.

lines.en: The traveler is wearing a thick coat.
segs: The traveler is wearing a thick coat.

lines.text: 바람이 말했어요. "저 외투를 먼저 벗기는 쪽이 이기기!"
lines.en: The Wind said, "Whoever makes that coat come off first wins!"
segs: Whoever makes that coat come off first wins!

lines.text: "저 외투쯤은 내가 휙 한 방에 날려 버릴걸!"
lines.en: I will blow that coat clean off in one big puff!
segs: I will blow that coat clean off in one big puff!

lines.text: 해님이 웃었어요. "좋아. 바람아, 너 먼저 해 봐."
lines.en: The Sun smiled. "Okay. Wind, you go first."
The Wind puffed out big, round cheeks.
segs: The Wind puffed out big, round cheeks.

lines.text: 후우! 바람이 힘껏 불자 풀잎이 휘청휘청 흔들렸어요.
lines.en: Whoosh! The Wind blew with all its might, and the grass swayed and swished.
segs: Whoosh! The Wind blew with all its might, and the grass swayed and swished.

lines.en: Whoosh~ The leaves are flying away!
segs: Whoosh~ The leaves are flying away!

lines.en: "Oh no, my hat!" The hat flew far, far away.
segs: The hat flew far, far away.

lines.en: The coat flap-flap-flaps!
"Brrr, it's cold!" The traveler held the coat tight.
segs: The traveler held the coat tight.

lines.text: 단추까지 꼭꼭 채웠어요. 외투는 꼼짝도 안 해요!
lines.en: Every button is buttoned up tight. The coat won't budge!
segs: Every button is buttoned up tight. The coat won't budge!

lines.en: The traveler hunched over and wobbled along, this way and that.
segs: The traveler hunched over and wobbled along, this way and that.

lines.en: The Wind blew even harder. Swish!
segs: The Wind blew even harder. Swish!

lines.text: 하지만 나그네는 외투를 꼭 붙잡고 끄떡도 하지 않았어요.
lines.en: But the traveler held his coat tight and did not budge one bit.
segs: But the traveler held his coat tight and did not budge one bit.

lines.text: 바람은 숨이 차서 헉헉, 볼이 쭈글쭈글해졌어요.
lines.en: The Wind ran out of breath, huff puff, and its cheeks went all wrinkly.
segs: The Wind ran out of breath, huff puff, and its cheeks went all wrinkly.

lines.en: "Aw, it's not working!"

lines.text: 어? 날아간 모자가 나그네 머리에 쏙 떨어졌어요!
lines.en: Oh? The hat that flew away dropped right onto the traveler's head!
segs: Oh? The hat that flew away dropped right onto the traveler's head!

lines.text: 나그네는 모자를 다시 쓰고 뚜벅뚜벅 걸어갔어요.
lines.en: The traveler put his hat back on and walked on, clomp, clomp.
segs: The traveler put his hat back on and walked on, clomp, clomp.

lines.en: Now it's the Sun's turn.

lines.text: 해님이 방긋 웃으며 따스한 햇살을 반짝반짝 쏟아 주었어요.
lines.en: The Sun smiled brightly and poured down warm sunshine, twinkle, twinkle.
segs: The Sun smiled brightly and poured down warm sunshine, twinkle, twinkle.

lines.en: "Ahh, so warm~" The traveler unbuttoned the coat.

lines.text: 햇살이 점점 쨍쨍, 나그네 이마에 땀이 송골송골 맺혔어요.
lines.en: The sunshine grew hotter and hotter, blazing bright, and little beads of sweat popped up on the traveler's forehead.
segs: The sunshine grew hotter and hotter, blazing bright, and little beads of sweat popped up on the traveler's forehead.

lines.en: "Phew, it's hot!" The traveler fans with the hat.
segs: The traveler fans with the hat.

lines.en: Phew! With the sun blazing like this, I do not need this coat.
segs: Phew! With the sun blazing like this, I do not need this coat.

lines.en: Off it goes! The traveler took off the coat!
segs: Off it goes! The traveler took off the coat!

lines.en: The Wind was so surprised. "Wow, the Sun did it!"

lines.text: 바람이 불 때, 나그네는 외투를 꽉 여몄어요.
lines.en: When the Wind blew, the traveler held the coat tight.
segs: When the Wind blew, the traveler held the coat tight.

lines.en: When the Sun shone, the traveler took the coat off.
segs: When the Sun shone, the traveler took the coat off.

lines.text: 바람은 머리를 긁적긁적, 해님은 싱글벙글 웃었어요.
lines.en: The Wind scratched its head, scritch, scratch, and the Sun grinned from ear to ear.
segs: The Wind scratched its head, scritch, scratch, and the Sun grinned from ear to ear.

lines.text: 세게 미는 것보다 다정한 게 더 힘이 세요.
lines.en: Being gentle is stronger than pushing hard.
segs: Being gentle is stronger than pushing hard.

lines.en: The traveler looked up at the Sun and gave a big, happy smile.
segs: The traveler looked up at the Sun and gave a big, happy smile.

lines.en: The traveler is resting by the stream.
segs: The traveler is resting by the stream.

lines.en: The traveler dipped both feet into the cool water, splash!
segs: The traveler dipped both feet into the cool water, splash!

lines.text: 졸졸졸 흐르는 물소리에 나그네는 콧노래를 흥얼흥얼.
lines.en: The stream babbled and burbled, and the traveler hummed a happy little tune.
segs: The stream babbled and burbled, and the traveler hummed a happy little tune.

lines.from: 바람아, 이번엔 살살 불어 줄래? 톡, 살살~
lines.en: Wind, could you blow gently this time?
segs: Wind, could you blow gently this time?

lines.text: 살랑살랑~ 부드러운 바람이 나그네 뺨을 간질였어요.
lines.en: Whisper, whisper~ A soft breeze tickled the traveler's cheeks.
segs: Whisper, whisper~ A soft breeze tickled the traveler's cheeks.

lines.en: "Ahh, so cool. Thank you, Wind!"
segs: Ahh, so cool. Thank you, Wind!

lines.text: 나그네는 외투를 돌돌 말아 베고 벌렁 드러누웠어요.
lines.en: The traveler rolled up his coat for a pillow and flopped down with a happy sigh.
segs: The traveler rolled up his coat for a pillow and flopped down with a happy sigh.

lines.en: The Sun and the Wind looked at each other and smiled.
segs: The Sun and the Wind looked at each other and smiled.

lines.text: 둘은 손을 꼭 잡고 흔들흔들, 악수를 했어요.
lines.en: They held hands tight and shook them up and down, up and down.
segs: They held hands tight and shook them up and down, up and down.

lines.en: "Let's be good friends!"
Yes! Together, we are even better!
segs: Yes! Together, we are even better!

lines.text: 해님은 반짝반짝, 바람은 살랑살랑, 하늘이 환해졌어요.
lines.en: The Sun twinkled, the Wind whispered softly, and the whole sky grew bright.
segs: The Sun twinkled, the Wind whispered softly, and the whole sky grew bright.

lines.text: 해님과 바람은 오늘도 사이좋게 하늘을 지켜요.
lines.en: The Sun and the Wind watch over the sky together again today.
segs: The Sun and the Wind watch over the sky together again today.

lines.text: 다정한 마음이 제일 힘이 세답니다. 끝!
lines.en: Kindness is the strongest power of all. The end!
segs: Kindness is the strongest power of all. The end!
